phase3_findings.description: RefusalRedactingRunner skips its WARNING log when _logged_by_guard sees a non-guard cause; reviewer says a flat-RLS scope-analysis refusal (rls.py ~238-246) and the readonly.py ~544-545 dialect refusal then leave no log record (criterion 26), and the _logged_by_guard docstring overstates. Orchestrator reading: RlsGuardRunner (safety/__init__.py:201-207) re-raises RlsError from RlsError, so the redactor does log; confirm before changing code.
ensure_catalog_confirmed logs only type(exc).__name__ for a non-RuleSetCatalogError failure; detail only in the traceback.

changelog.d/389.added.md:8-9 'saves nothing to memory' overstates: usage counters and timestamps are still written on retrieval.
verify-memory comment in cli.py says the rule-set check runs before every other argument and config check; config loading runs first.
